body.purpose: Messages, settings, and explanatory copy with system scaling.

motion.name: state-standard

components.name: Primary Button Dark
components.description: The single high-emphasis action on a dark task surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-dark { background:#07F2FB; color:#02082C; border:0; border-radius:10px; padding:10px 16px; font:600 12px/1.25 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace; transition:background 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary-dark:hover { background:#5AF4F7; } .ds-btn-primary-dark:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #EAFBFF; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary-dark:active { background:#0DD5F0; }

components.name: Ghost Button Dark
components.description: A secondary action that preserves task hierarchy.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost-dark { background:transparent; color:#A8DCEB; border:1px solid #044875; border-radius:10px; padding:9px 15px; font:500 12px/1.25 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace; transition:border-color 180ms ease-out,color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost-dark:hover { color:#EAFBFF; border-color:#0DD5F0; } .ds-btn-ghost-dark:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0DD5F0; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Host Input Dark
components.description: A compact address or pairing field on an ocean surface.
components.css: .ds-input-dark { background:#022753; color:#EAFBFF; border:1px solid #044875; border-radius:10px; padding:10px 12px; font:400 14px/1.4 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace; } .ds-input-dark:focus { outline:2px solid #0DD5F0; outline-offset:1px; border-color:#0DD5F0; } .ds-input-dark::selection { background:#0DD5F0; color:#02082C; }

components.name: Selected Runtime Chip
components.description: A selected harness or runtime with both shape and color reinforcement.
components.css: .ds-runtime-chip-selected { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; background:#011B44; color:#EAFBFF; border:1px solid #0DD5F0; border-radius:8px; padding:6px 9px; font:500 12px/1.25 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace; } .ds-runtime-chip-selected:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #07F2FB; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Host Container
components.description: A flat tonal container for host identity, transport state, and actions.
components.css: .ds-host-container { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; background:#011B44; color:#EAFBFF; border:1px solid #044875; border-radius:12px; padding:12px; font:400 14px/1.4 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace; } .ds-host-container strong { font-weight:600; } .ds-host-container span { color:#A8DCEB; font-size:12px; }

narrative.overview: Remora is a restrained native product interface shaped by the deep water in its canonical icon. Dark mode uses layered navy rather than pure black; light mode uses cool ocean-tinted neutrals rather than sterile white. Bright cyan is rare and directional: it marks primary actions, focus, selection, and links. The interface is dense enough for professional coding-agent work but remains calm under sustained use. It explicitly rejects the original fork's black-and-neon-green terminal identity, generic royal-blue AI dashboards, and decorative glass or gradient treatments. User-selected terminal palettes are content, not app chrome, and remain visually independent.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy tonal layering with no decorative shadows.
Green, amber, and red reserved for semantic state.
Native controls, compact spacing, and mono-forward typography.
Cross-platform role parity without pixel-for-pixel imitation.

rules.name: The One Current Rule
rules.body: Cyan owns action and focus and should occupy no more than roughly ten percent of a task screen. Its rarity gives it authority.

rules.name: The Semantic Waterline Rule
rules.body: Green always means success or connected, amber means pending or warning, and red means failure or danger. Brand cyan must never replace these states.

rules.name: The Terminal Isolation Rule
rules.body: App chrome follows this system; Ghostty and other user-selected terminal themes retain their own palettes without tinting.

rules.name: The Native Scale Rule
rules.body: Preserve Dynamic Type and Android font scaling. Fixed sizes describe defaults only and never cap accessibility scaling.

rules.name: The Water-Column Rule
rules.body: Elevation is a three-step surface scale, not a shadow stack: base, surface, raised surface.

dos: Do derive new brand color from the documented ocean roles.
Do use cyan for primary action, current selection, focus, and links.
Do preserve semantic green, amber, and red with text, icons, or shapes.
Do keep iOS and Android role-equivalent while respecting native controls.
Do preserve user-selected terminal palettes and remote content colors.
Do verify WCAG 2.2 AA contrast in both appearance modes.
donts: Don't restore the original fork's black-and-neon-green terminal identity.
Don't build a generic hacker-terminal surface that uses green for every action and state.
Don't use Codex royal blue (#0169CC) as Remora's primary identity.
Don't build stock blue SaaS or AI dashboards with ornamental gradients, glass cards, or decorative glows.
Don't use side-stripe accents, gradient text, or wide soft card shadows.
Don't recolor Ghostty or another user-selected terminal theme to match app chrome.
